$comment: EXP-1249: the composer's ONE '+' menu, byte-identical x4 (web components/launch-dialog/composer-menu.ts, desktop chat_screen.rs + launch_options.rs, iOS AgentComposerCard.swift, Android AgentComposer.kt). The '+' is the composer's ONLY tool (the Issue and Action tools and the options line's '...' overflow are gone; #EXP-1434 owner 2026-10-29 AMENDS NEW-2: 'an entry for prompts would be good, such that you dont have to type "/" necessarily': the team's prompts are ALSO the `prompts` row here, the `/` menu keeps them too); md+ = a dropdown anchored at the '+', phones = a bottom sheet of the same rows, submenus as pushed pages. Rows in `rows` order; a row with `when` renders only while that condition holds (`conditions` says when), then separators are TIDIED (never leading, trailing or doubled). Icons are CONCEPTS (packages/icons/icons.json). Submenus (SLOP-28, EXP-1259 D5): implement-issue is, the shared search list (search-list.json: a search input on top, Picker rows of ONE height `submenuRowHeight`, the list scrolls, at most `submenuMaxRows` rows visible, bottom fade); on a pointer they open to the side on hover or Right arrow (Left/Escape closes back to the parent), on phones they push as pages. implement-issue = issue rows (status glyph, mono identifier, title; the picks pinned first, checkmarks) with a footer button `implementButton` once something is picked (it only closes the menu: the picks are already the subject); effort = picker rows over the agent's efforts, value = the picked effort's label, label `codexLabel` for codex, DISABLED while ultracode is on; subagents = THE model picker rows (the contract coding models, all four, NO Default: every model is explicit, device default `deviceAgentDefaults.subagentModel`), value = the picked label; mcp-servers = multi picker rows over the team's servers (a server the caller has not connected opens Settings > MCP servers instead of toggling), value = the number picked (no value at zero). add-file ('Photo or file') opens the platform file chooser with NO type filter (any file: images up to 10 MB keep their [Image #N] marker, other files up to 50 MB ride as file links, 4 of each); iOS alone opens a two-entry GlassMenu 'Photo' | 'File' (the photo picker | fileImporter(.item)), the one iOS-only sub-choice. S-3 (owner 2026-10-28, mobile is the reference): EVERY composer ×4 (the launch composer, a session's, an agent chat's: `surface` launch | session | agent) has ONLY the '+' as its tool: NO options line under the card (Device, Account, Model and Repository are + rows now), NO inline image/file/#/emoji/mention buttons (emoji stays only in the issue comment composer). A row's `surfaces` = where it exists; `when` (one condition or a list, all must hold) = when it shows. Rows: add-file 'Photo or file' (iOS keeps its Photo | File sub-choice), implement-issue 'Issue' (launch: the implement subject picker; session/agent: THE same issue search list, a pick inserts `#IDENT` at the caret), a separator, then the RUNNER submenus over THE existing pickers as submenu rows (search-list.json; value = the picked label): device (picker-device), account (picker-account), model (ModelPicker), repository (picker-repository, only while the team has `repositories` > 1), each only where it can change (`device`/`account`/`model` conditions: the launch composer while the agent row picks `Temporary session`; a session's model while it runs on a model-switching agent; an agent chat's model; a running session never moves device or login here). On launch the WORK picks follow (effort, subagents, ultracode, MCP servers, computer use) only for a temporary session (`temporary`): a message to an agent runs on that agent's definition. The old `message-agent` row and its agent chip are GONE: the composer-home.json agent row picks the recipient. EXP-1345 picker rule ×4 (owner 2026-10-17): a single-select pick is THE Picker (selected row's ui-check TRAILING; md+ = a popover at the trigger, phones = a bottom sheet of the same rows); action menus (context menus, the '+') stay THE Menu. The Agent page draws NO suggestion rows and NO brand-mark watermark (composer-home.json owns the page around the card). The options line's Resume pill is GONE with it ×4 (owner 2026-10-28): no + row; a send uses the stored resume default (on). #EXP-1434 (owner 2026-10-29, ×4 the same): PROMPTS row `prompts` ('Prompts', the concept `coding-command`, every surface, while the team has a prompt: `prompts`) right after Issue = THE search list (search-list.json) over the team's prompts in the `/` menu's order (row = the prompt's own icon in the default muted tint, as the `/` menu draws it (prompts carry no colour), + its name; the input filters by name like the `/` filter); a pick does EXACTLY what picking it in the `/` menu does (a session/agent composer inserts its body into the draft at the caret; the launch composer makes it the new session's subject) and closes the menu. ACCOUNT LIMITS: the account submenu's rows carry THE EXP-992 usage preview of picker-account (`AccountPicker`, `accountLimitWindows`: the 5h, week and model windows as UsageWindows density `hover`): on a pointer a hover card beside the hovered row, on touch the bars inline under the row's label; a login with no `limits` shows none.

conditions.temporary: launch: the agent row (composer-home.json `agentRow`) picks Temporary session (no agent)
conditions.device: the device can change here: launch while temporary; never in a session or an agent chat
conditions.account: the login can change here: launch while temporary; never in a session or an agent chat
conditions.model: the model can change here: launch while temporary; a session or an agent chat whose agent switches models (always for claude and codex)
conditions.repositories: the team has more than one repository
conditions.subagentModel: the picked agent takes a subagent model (claude)
conditions.mcp: the team has at least one MCP server
conditions.computerUse: the picked device advertises the `computerUse.cap` capability
conditions.prompts: the team has at least one prompt (the `/` menu lists it)

computerUse.$comment: Per-run computer use. The start payload key sits next to `mcpServerIds` in steer.startSession, codingSessions.start and the relay's start frame; true/false = this run, absent or null = the device's launch_defaults.computerUse. The toggle seeds from that device default on every device change and rides out only to a device advertising `cap` (older builds would ignore it).

cases.name: launch, temporary, claude on a computer-use device with MCP servers and two repos: every row
launch, temporary, codex, one repo, no MCP servers: the last group goes with its separator
launch with an agent picked: no runner and no work rows
an agent chat: the same rows as a session
a session whose agent cannot switch models
#EXP-1434: a session on a team with prompts: the Prompts row follows Issue
